name: 30047 · Lilburn, GA
findings: ZIP 30047 (Lilburn) has 253 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30047 (Lilburn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
